questions.question: Jesus called a little child to stand among His disciples. What did He say will happen unless they change and become like little children?

answers.text: They will never enter the kingdom of heaven
They will be the least among their brothers
They will lose the reward they have earned

questions.question: When the disciples asked who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven, who did Jesus say is the greatest?

answers.text: Whoever humbles himself like a little child
Whoever gives the most away to the poor
Whoever has followed Him the longest

questions.question: In Jesus' story of a man with a hundred sheep, what did the man do when one sheep wandered off?

answers.text: Left the ninety-nine and searched for the lost one
Stayed with the ninety-nine and waited for it to return
Sent his servants out to bring it home

questions.question: If your brother sins against you and will not listen when you go to him privately, what does Jesus say to do next?

answers.text: Take one or two others along
Let it drop and move on
